description: This Java source file defines the Subscriber actor class used in a pub/sub system within the Eclipse Ditto project. The class manages subscriptions and message distribution to local subscribers via Akka actors, handling message classification, topic extraction, and subscription updates.

classes.name: Subscriber
classes.description: A generic Akka actor class responsible for distributing pub/sub messages to local subscribers based on message topics and subscription data.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Static factory method to create Props configuration for this actor, parameterized by message class and topic extractor.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Overridden method defining the actor's message handling logic, matching message class instances and subscription updates.

methods.name: broadcastToLocalSubscribers
methods.description: Private method to distribute a message to all local subscribers interested in the message's topics, updating metrics counters.

methods.name: updateLocalSubscriptions
methods.description: Private method to update the actor's current subscriptions.
